categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on property rights and land administration without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related matters. The document is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" which confirms its land-related nature.
